title: thread.yml — the cache
$comment: A cache folded from log.jsonl plus origin.md's frontmatter, regenerated by the tool; hand edits are discarded. It makes `view` and `list` cheap without replaying the log, so every field must be derivable from those files.

supersedes.description: Legacy pointer from the retired supersede command.

superseded-by.description: Legacy pointer from the retired supersede command.

events-since-checkpoint.description: Feeds the presence banner and the unsynced flag. Being unsynced is a property of the thread, not of a session.

unsynced.description: events-since-checkpoint is past the nudge threshold.

claims.description: Present sessions. Presence not ownership; stale shown stale, never removed by the fold (a `release` removes).

last-seen.description: Timestamp of this session's most recent event on this thread — the derived heartbeat.

merged.description: The child's final checkpoint id, set when this parent recorded `child-merged`.

links.description: One-sided relationships folded from linked and unlinked events. Reverse relationships are found by scanning thread.yml files.

scratch-newer-than-checkpoint.description: Count for the banner; computed from mtimes, so it is the one field here that is not a log fold. Doctor: 'review before checkpointing.'

tasks-hash.description: Hash of tasks.yml as last observed, so hand edits can be diffed into the log on the next command.
